verification_report.summary: The proof was checked sequentially, including every deduction in the lifting, monomial-domination, simultaneous-principalization, finite-set approximation, comparison, and conditional finite-energy arguments. The compactness/density lift covers proper-support semivaluations; the annihilator argument establishes domination on all coherent ideals; and the v3 central-ideal argument correctly forces every discarded zero-value divisor to have zero value under the chosen monomial valuation. The finite-set construction yields a genuinely pointwise-convergent dominated net, including coordinates equal to +infinity. The cited MP24 and DXZ23 statements, analytic principalization theorem, multiplier-ideal formula, and MP-DXZ normalization interface were checked and apply with matching definitions and hypotheses. Under the expressly stipulated P14.2 upper-semicontinuity assumption, both corollaries follow. No critical error or gap was found.
